## WSA change receipt

### Changed
Describe exactly what changed.

### Tested
Describe tests and environment.

### Not tested
List remaining verification.

### Production impact
- [ ] No production impact
- [ ] Customer-visible behavior changes
- [ ] Messaging changes
- [ ] Booking changes
- [ ] Billing/payment changes
- [ ] Authentication/security changes

### Secrets / data
- [ ] No secrets committed
- [ ] No unnecessary production PII included

### Rollback
Describe how to revert.

### Remaining work
List anything incomplete.

### Claimed status
PLANNED / BUILT / TESTED / LIVE-VERIFIED / VERIFY / LEGACY / RETIRED
